note: examples consume published packages; the unreleased typed API needs the local feed (packed by C13). The literal `dotnet build <example> -c Debug` cannot resolve the typed API from published 1.0.9-rc2.
packaging_caveat: OPEN PACKAGING CAVEAT (for CHECK): the AdventureWorks example consumes PUBLISHED packages (`examples/Directory.Packages.props` NextOrmVersion), and the typed PIVOT/UNPIVOT API is not in the published 1.0.9-rc2. C13 therefore builds against a locally packed 1.0.9-rc3-local feed (/tmp/opencode/t232-feed) with -p:NextOrmVersion=1.0.9-rc3-local -p:RestoreAdditionalProjectSources=<feed>. The example compiles only after that local pack; the plain literal command against published rc2 fails to resolve the typed API. Publishing rc3 removes the caveat.
